name: All-bold single grotesque
description: Faces: one grotesque, every size bold; a squared, engineered grotesque of the kind used on signs and instruments suits it as well as a plain one. Display at 700-800 in mixed case, 48-64px (3.3-4.4vw at 1440), leading 0.86-1.0, tracking -0.01em, two lines at most; then 40 / 32 / 24px, body at 600-700 and 16-20px (leading 1.35), small text 14-15px at the same weight in sentence case. Ratio about 3x, so hierarchy cannot come from weight or size: it comes from cards on the one surface tone that group each sub-head with its lines, from the change of ground and from position (section headings stand on the ground, never in a card). Sentences stay under 14 words and paragraphs at two or three lines; long bold text tires the eye. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action, links and key figures, never a coloured word in a headline and never a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps ink for the accent. A 48-64px headline does not fill the first screen alone, so the dealt hero's large photograph carries it.
phone: Display 34-40px, body 16-18px at the same weight, measure 30-34 characters, leading opened by 0.05; cards stack full width.
houseRuleCheck: A page only of boxes is banned: deal it with photograph sections between the card sections. Cards sit on the one surface tone; the accent is not a fill.

name: Ultra-tight black caps poster word
description: Faces: one grotesque with a true 900 weight for the headline (the heaviest loaded weight where the dealt face stops lower, never a faked bold) and its regular cut for text. The headline is one to three words in black caps on one or two lines at 11-17vw (160-245px at 1440), leading 0.84-0.9, tracking -0.06 to -0.1em, tightened until the letters almost touch but never overlap. Text is the regular cut at 16-18px, tracking -0.02em, leading 1.35; captions the same face in sentence case at 15px, weight 500; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Ratio 13-19x: a poster-scale word and ordinary text with nothing between. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, the headline in full-contrast ink; the accent on the primary action only. Motion: the word arrives with the dealt entrance and then holds still; links flip ink on hover.
phone: Word stacked on two lines at most at 20-24vw so no line is wider than the screen minus the margins; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: No decorative accent word: the poster word is a content word, never a giant name in the footer; headline on two lines at most, buttons and entrance as dealt.

name: Black condensed poster over serif text
description: A black (900) condensed grotesque in capitals for one poster word at about 27vw over a transitional serif that carries the reading text, with a plain sans for captions. The poster word is about 385px at 1440, leading 0.9, one word, or two short words stacked, so it fills the content width inside the margins; set as live text in a condensed cut or width axis (the heaviest loaded weight where the face stops below 900), never as drawn paths and never a stretched copy. Serif text at 30 / 26 / 20 / 18px, tracking -0.03em, leading 1.1-1.4, three lines at most per block, carries about 60% of what is read; captions are the sans at 14-15px, sentence case; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Ratio about 19x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the poster in full-contrast ink, the serif in a softer ink at 4.5:1 or better; the accent on the primary action only. Motion: the poster arrives with the dealt entrance and then holds still.
phone: Poster 38-42vw on two stacked lines at most (about 150px) so it spans the width; serif 20 / 18px; captions 14-15px.
houseRuleCheck: The poster word is live text and a content word, never a giant name in the footer; no stretched copy, no scroll-across move; captions plain sans sentence case.

name: Black grotesque heads, regular body
description: Faces: one grotesque with 400 and 900 cuts (the true black only; the heaviest loaded weight where the dealt face stops lower). Heads in black (900), mixed case: 100px for the hero and 72px (5vw) for section heads at 1440, leading 0.9-1.0, tracking -0.02em, two lines at most. Body 400 at 16-18px, leading 1.45; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Ratio about 6.3x. The contrast is between black and regular, with nothing in between: no 700 or 800 steps. Keep heads to three or four words. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; links change colour on hover.
phone: Heads 40-44px and 36px, body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after the pass: no own button size or weight, entrance as dealt, accent off cards.

name: Bold caps display, plain UI
description: A bold (700) grotesque in capitals for the display over an extended sans at 500-600 for navigation and the rare paragraph. Display at 11.5vw (165px at 1440), leading 0.84, tracking -0.02em, one or two lines; section headings reuse the display at its low end (7-8vw), so there are no mid headings. Links stay 16px, weight 600, sentence case, no tracking, and navigation and buttons keep the dealt designs; a paragraph is rare, one 20px line at leading 1.35. Ratio about 10x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action only. Motion: the display arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover changes colour.
phone: Display 16-17vw so the longest word fits (60-66px); interface 16px.
houseRuleCheck: The interface type is 16px sentence case, never small tracked capitals; navigation, buttons and entrance as dealt; the id's 'micro-caps' no longer applies.

name: Bold caps neo, caps lead
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at 700 with a 400-500 for small text. Display in 700 caps at 8.6-10.4vw (124-150px at 1440), tracking -0.03 to -0.06em, leading 0.8-0.95, two lines at most per statement. The lead, and short body blocks of up to two lines, stay in bold caps at 18-30px, leading 1.1, no tracking; middle heads in mixed case 700 at 44-56px. Everything under 18px (captions, form hints, legal lines) is sentence case at 15px or more, so caps never sets small text, and a paragraph longer than two lines goes to sentence case. Ratio 5-8x: a voice that shouts in short lines and explains in quiet ones. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links, never recolouring part of a headline and never a card fill. Motion: display lines arrive with the dealt entrance; links invert ink and ground on hover.
phone: Display 15-17vw capped so the longest word fits (about 56-62px); lead 20px caps; body 16px sentence case; one column.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only at 18px and up, untracked; a caps block stays within two lines; anything smaller is sentence case; accent kept off cards and headline words.

name: Bold geometric heads
description: Faces: a geometric sans at 700 for headings and 400 for text; a neutral grotesque at 13-14px for fine print is optional. Heading ladder 74 / 46 / 40 / 28 / 24px (5.1vw at the top at 1440), leading 1.0 at the top easing to 1.4, tracking 0: round letters need air, so no tight tracking. Body 17px at leading 1.55. Ratio about 4.6x. The round bowls give a friendly voice; keep headings in mixed case, short, two lines at most. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; links change colour on hover.
phone: Ladder 38 / 30 / 26 / 22 / 20px, body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after the pass: two-line headings, ground and accent as dealt (no cream-and-terracotta pairing), entrance as dealt.

name: Bold humanist heads, tight
description: Faces: one humanist sans with 400 and 700 (open apertures, a little stroke contrast). Headings in 700, mixed case, at 82 / 46 / 37px (5.7vw at the top at 1440), tracking -0.035 to -0.043em, leading 1.1; body 400 at 16px, leading 1.5; small text 14px, leading 1.8. Ratio about 5x. The tight tracking suits humanist letters; keep headings to one or two lines. The voice is approachable and capable. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink a deep neutral; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; links change colour on hover.
phone: Headings 42 / 30 / 26px at tracking -0.03em; body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after the pass: entrance as dealt, accent off cards, ground and ink as dealt.

name: Bold tight grotesque at large scale
description: Faces: one grotesque or neo-grotesque at 400 and 700; a second plain sans at 500 for small text is optional. Display in 700 at 9.7-11.7vw (140-168px at 1440), tracking -0.03 to -0.05em, leading 0.78-0.85, on a ladder of about 128 / 94 / 57 / 33px; body 400 at 17px, tracking -0.02em, leading 1.4; small text 14-15px at 500 in sentence case. Ratio 8-9x. The leading is so tight that lines nearly touch: check that descenders (g, y, p) clear the ascenders of the next line and open the leading to 0.85 where they collide. Keep headlines to one or two lines of four words or fewer. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at the strongest contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; hover on links changes colour only.
phone: Display 14-16vw (56-64px) if the words are short, else 12vw; ladder 56 / 40 / 28 / 22; body 16px; leading opened to 0.9.
houseRuleCheck: No condensed accent word and no second small voice: small text is the body sans at 14-15px, sentence case; the id's 'mono-labels' no longer applies.

name: Bold title-case serif poster
description: Faces: one transitional serif with 400 and 700 does every job. Display in 700 title case at 15vw (216px at 1440), one or two words only; then 104 and 84px in title case, leading 1.1, tracking -0.01em; body 400 at 20px, leading 1.38. Ratio about 11x. Title case, not caps; emphasis comes from weight, never italics inside a headline. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at strong contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: the display arrives with the dealt entrance and holds still; hover lightens or darkens ink.
phone: Display 20vw on one or two words (about 78px); steps 52 / 40px; body 18px.
houseRuleCheck: No italics inside a headline; the display is a content word, never a giant name in the footer; no scroll scale or slide.

name: Caps didone over caps sans
description: A didone at 400 in capitals for every heading over a clean neo-grotesque or geometric sans at 400-500 that also sets short blocks in capitals. Headings run 100-120px at 1440 (7-8vw), leading 0.9-1.0, tracking -0.03em, two lines at most, then 46 and 30px; keep the top step at 64px or more so the fine strokes survive, and nothing in mixed case in the headings. The sans sets short blocks (two lines at most) in capitals at 18-21px, tracking no wider than +0.02em; longer paragraphs and anything under 18px stay in sentence case at 16-17px; navigation and buttons keep the size and case of the dealt designs. Ratio 5.5-8.5x: a fully capitalised, formal voice. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent muted, on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headings arrive with the dealt entrance; links shift ink on hover.
phone: Didone caps 13vw (about 50px) on short words so the thin strokes hold; sans caps lines 18px; long text sentence case 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals in the sans only at 18px and up with at most +0.02em; long text and anything smaller in sentence case; navigation and buttons as dealt.

name: Caps didone, light sans body
description: A didone at 400-500 in capitals for the display over a light-to-regular neo-grotesque (300-400; 400 where the dealt face has no lighter cut) in mixed case for everything read. The display runs 70-180px (5-12.6vw at 1440), one size per section rather than every size at once, two lines at most, leading 1.0, tracking -0.02em, with a capitals middle step in the display face near 24px. Body 16-17px at leading 1.5; captions in the same sans, sentence case, 14px, no tracking; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Ratio 5-7x: the display is the show and the body quiet and airy. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink soft but at 4.5:1 or better; the accent muted, on the primary action only. Motion: the display arrives with the dealt entrance; hover softens ink slightly.
phone: Display 11-13vw (44-52px); middle step 20px caps; body 16px at leading 1.55.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in the display and the 24px middle step; captions are 14px sentence case, untracked; entrance and buttons as dealt.

name: Caps top step, mixed-case statements
description: Faces: one grotesque at 500, with a bolder cut for short small lines. Only the top step is caps: 8.3vw (120px at 1440), leading 0.8-0.9, tracking -0.01em, two lines at most. Below it, statements as short mixed-case headlines at 46px (leading 1.1, two lines at most, marked up as h2 or h3), a large lead at 28-30px (leading 1.2, three lines at most) that reads like a statement itself, a 22px h3, and 18px bold sentence-case small lines. Ratio about 4x. The page speaks in short big sentences, so each section holds one statement and little else. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: statements arrive with the dealt entrance; hover lifts ink toward the accent.
phone: Top step 13vw (about 52px) caps; statements 30px; lead 22-24px on four lines at most; bold small 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only on the 120px top step; statements are short headlines of two lines at most; the lead stays at 30px or less on three lines.

name: Regular caps display stack
description: Faces: one normal-width sans at 400-500; the same family in sentence case sets text at 16-18px. Everything large is caps on a deep stack of five or six display sizes between 5vw and 22vw (72-317px at 1440). Never more than three of the sizes in view at once: the hero word (one word of seven letters or fewer) fills the width at 20-22vw, section titles run 8-12vw on one or two lines, sub lines 5vw. Leading 0.8-1.0, tracking 0 to -0.01em. Ratio 10-19x. Text stays small and plain so the stack reads as scale, not as shouting. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: the giant word arrives with the dealt entrance and then holds still; hover changes ink only.
phone: Stack becomes 18vw / 12vw / 8vw / 6vw; every display word fits on one line, so pick words of seven letters or fewer for the hero.
houseRuleCheck: The giant hero word is a content word and never comes back as a giant name in the footer; no scroll step-down, no pin.

name: Small flared-serif caps, no display
description: A flared serif (stroke ends widen slightly) in capitals at 32px for heads over a grotesque for text, with almost no display step: the type barely rises above 32px, so large photographs, cards on the one surface tone and space carry the page. The display face sets the 32px heads (tracking -0.04em, leading 0.9) and 18px sub-heads in capitals; the grotesque sets running text in mixed case at 16px, and navigation and buttons keep the dealt designs. Ratio about 2x. Every screen needs a big photograph or a group of cards to make rank, because the type will not; the hero is a full-screen photograph with the 32px line set on a quiet area of it. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink one step off full contrast; the accent muted, on the primary action and links only. Motion: headings arrive with the dealt entrance; links shift ink on hover.
phone: Serif caps 26px and 18px, grotesque text 16px; same faces, one column.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only at 18px and up, untracked, so no letter-spaced labels; navigation and buttons as dealt. Deal it only with picture-led sections, since no display step fills the first screen.

name: Caps grotesque, didone second voice
description: A grotesque at 400 in capitals for the display and short lines over a didone, also in capitals, as the second voice for section heads. The sans sets the display at 105px (7.3vw at 1440), two lines at most, and short lines at 18px; the didone sets the 53px section heads. If the dealt navigation opens a menu list, that list takes the sans capitals at the head step. Everything big is capitals at leading 1.0; running text is the sans at 16px in sentence case. Each headline is wholly one face; the two never mix inside a headline. Ratio about 7x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent muted, on the primary action and links only. Motion: headings arrive with the dealt entrance; links tint toward the accent on hover.
phone: Display 12vw (about 47px), heads 30px, body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Each headline uses one face only (a second face inside a headline would be an accent word, which the id's 'accent' never meant); capitals at 18px and up, running text sentence case; no own full-screen menu.

name: Caps old-style ladder, extended text
description: An old-style serif at 400 in capitals for every heading over a wide-set grotesque at 400-500 for the text. Heading ladder 144 / 96 / 72 / 56 / 40 / 24px (10vw at the top at 1440), two lines at most, tracking -0.064em at the top easing to -0.01em at 24px (letters near but never touching), leading 0.83-1.0. Text in the wide grotesque in sentence case at 16px, leading 1.5; wide letters read larger, so 16px does the work of 18. Ratio about 9x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headings arrive with the dealt entrance; links tint on hover.
phone: Top step 15vw (about 58px), then 40 / 30 / 24 / 20; text 16px, one column.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in headings, 24px and up; text in sentence case; headings two lines at most; entrance as dealt.

name: Caps sans line above a caps serif line
description: Two display lines in capitals, a bold (700) humanist sans line above a transitional serif line, over a geometric sans at 400 for text. Line one at 8.2vw (118px at 1440), tracking -0.03em, leading 0.9; line two at about 112px directly under it, matched to the same width so the pair reads as one block of two lines. Each face keeps its own line; the two never mix within a line. Text at 16-17px in sentence case, leading 1.5. Ratio about 7x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action only. Motion: both lines arrive with the dealt entrance and then hold still.
phone: Both lines at 11vw, wrapping at word boundaries; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Each face keeps its own line, so there is no accent word; no tracked caps tagline or label (the id's 'wide-tracked' never applied), no decorative glyph face; entrance as dealt.

name: Caps serif poster, jump to text
description: A transitional serif at 400 in capitals for one poster word at 22vw, and in sentence case for one h2, over a neutral neo-grotesque for everything read. The poster word is 320px at 1440 (lh 0.91, 0 to -0.01em), three to seven letters on one line so it stays inside the 1344px content width. The h2 is the display face at 89px, mixed case (lh 1.0, max 900px, one or two lines). Then a straight jump to the sans: body 19-20px (-0.02em, lh 1.45, max 520px) and captions at 13px sentence case 500 in the dealt muted tone. No h3 and no sub tier: the page skips the middle, and a card title is the body size in the heavier weight. Ratio about 16x, step ratio from poster to h2 about 3.6. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Poster word fitted to one line between the phone margins (about 22vw, 86px at five letters; never split across lines); h2 44px; body 17px; captions 13px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only on the one poster word, a content word never used as a name in the footer; captions are 13px sentence case.

name: Small condensed black over extended text
description: A condensed black (900) grotesque in capitals for heads at only 3.8vw over an extended grotesque at 600-700 that carries about 90% of the text. The display is 55px at 1440, leading 0.85, tracking 0, two lines at most, with a 23px step; the extended text runs at 16px, sentence case, weight 600, tracking 0. The contrast is width, not size: narrow heavy heads against wide small text. Ratio about 3.4x. The page has no giant type, so the dealt hero's full-screen photograph carries the first screen, with the headline on a quiet area of it. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headings arrive with the dealt entrance; hover inverts ink on a link.
phone: Heads 36px, 20px step, extended text 16px; one column.
houseRuleCheck: The extended text is 16px sentence case, never small capitals (the id's 'micro-text' no longer applies); accent off cards; entrance as dealt.

name: Condensed caps as seasoning over neo text
description: A condensed grotesque at 500 in capitals, used sparingly (about 4% of the characters), over a neo-grotesque for everything else. The condensed display is 5.3vw (76px at 1440), leading 1.0, tracking 0, two lines at most, only for the first-screen headline and the section headings. The neo-grotesque's display cut at 500 sets the 20-24px sub-heads, and its text at 400-500 runs at 16px, leading 1.5. Ratio about 4.8x. The condensed face is a seasoning, never the body. The headline does not fill the screen alone, so the dealt hero's photograph carries it. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; link hover tints ink.
phone: Condensed 36px (10vw), sub-heads 20px, text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in the condensed display; all text in sentence case; accent off cards; entrance as dealt.

name: Condensed poster with editorial voices
description: A condensed grotesque in capitals for the poster at 22vw over three supporting voices, each with one job: a geometric sans in capitals for the h2 and big labels, a light old-style serif for story text and a light neo-grotesque for fine print (where the dealt system has fewer faces, the jobs split by size, case and weight). The poster is 322px at 1440, leading 0.8, then 160px; the geometric capitals run 56-64px; the serif story text 30-36px at leading 1.25, three lines at most per block; fine print 16px. Ratio about 20x. The jobs are shout (condensed), name (geometric capitals), tell (serif) and annotate (small sans); never swap them. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the serif in a softer ink at 4.5:1 or better; the accent on the primary action and links only. Motion: the poster arrives with the dealt entrance and holds still, never pinned; hover shifts colour only.
phone: Poster 30vw (about 117px); geometric caps 34px; serif 24px; fine print 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only at 56px and up; the poster word is never a giant name in the footer; story text 36px or less; no pin.

name: Condensed caps poster, rounded display word
description: Faces: one condensed grotesque in capitals for almost everything, plus one bubbly, soft-cornered decorative display face for whole standalone words. The poster word is one word set to span the content width on one line, 20-35vw (288-504px at 1440) by its length, kept inside the page margins, with a second size at 15vw (216px) and leading 0.8-0.85 so a stacked second line nearly touches without its glyphs overlapping. Sub-heads at 40px capitals, body at 20-26px in the same condensed family, three lines at most per block. The decorative face covers about 12% of the type as whole words or one line on its own, never a word inside a headline. Ratio about 17x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at strong contrast; the decorative word in the ink too, told apart by its face alone; the accent stays on the primary action and links. Motion: the poster arrives with the dealt entrance and then holds still, with no parallax.
phone: Poster 40vw stacked on two lines (about 150px); sub-heads 28px; body 20px.
houseRuleCheck: The decorative face sets standalone words only (inside a headline it would be an accent word) and takes no accent colour; the poster word is never a giant name in the footer; buttons and entrance as dealt.

name: Condensed caps at every step
description: Faces: one condensed grotesque at 500 in caps for every display step: 150 / 140 / 120 / 95 / 80 / 64px (10.4vw at the top at 1440), leading 0.8-1.2, tracking 0. Text at 17-18px in the same family in sentence case, since small condensed caps are hard to read. Ratio about 12.5x. A single narrow family means a headline can set two lines of different sizes into one poster block, never more than two lines; keep the stack to three sizes per section. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: the block arrives with the dealt entrance and holds still; hover changes colour only.
phone: Top step 15vw (about 58px), steps 40-52px; text 17px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in the display; text in sentence case; a headline block stays within two lines; no scroll step-down.

name: Decorative caps display, plain UI
description: A decorative display face with real character (inline cuts, quirky terminals or flared stems) in capitals over a grotesque at 300-400 (400 where the dealt face has no lighter cut) for everything small. Display at 8.4vw (121px at 1440), leading 0.83, tracking 0 to -0.02em, two lines at most, one display line per section so it stays an event, not a texture. Text and captions are the grotesque at 16px, weight 400, sentence case, leading 1.4; navigation and buttons keep the dealt designs. Ratio about 7.5x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent on the primary action only. Motion: the display arrives with the dealt entrance as whole words, never split into letters; hover shifts ink.
phone: Display 12vw (about 47px), wrapping at word boundaries; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Small text is 16px sentence case, never small tracked capitals (the id's 'micro-caps' no longer applies); no ornament glyph stands in as a drawn shape; entrance as dealt.

name: Compact didone, sans body, book-roman notes
description: A didone at 400 for the display and sub-heads over a neo-grotesque at 500 for the body, with a small book roman with serifs as a quiet third voice for captions. Display in mixed case at 5vw (72px at 1440), leading 1.0, two lines at most; sub-heads in the display face's capitals at 30px (-0.04em) and 21px quotes; body in the sans at 16px (-0.02em, leading 1.4); captions and short notes (one or two lines) in the book roman at 14px, sentence case, no tracking, or in the sans when the page keeps to two faces. Ratio about 4.5x from display to body, with the steps above the body close together (72 / 30 / 21px). Quiet and magazine-like: type never leads, so photographs carry the screen and the hero is a full-screen photograph with the 72px headline on a quiet area of it. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink one step off full contrast; the accent muted, on the primary action only. Motion: headings arrive with the dealt entrance; nothing else moves.
phone: Display 38px; sub-heads 24px caps; body 16px; notes 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Notes are 14px sentence case, untracked, one or two lines; capitals only in the 30px sub-heads; the id's 'caps-labels' no longer applies.

name: Loose-leaded didone over neo
description: A didone at 400 in mixed case for the display over a neo-grotesque at 400 for body and captions; no capitals, no italics. Display at 7.6vw (110px at 1440) with open leading of 1.38 so the lines float apart; follow-on steps at 78 and 72px at leading 1.05; body at 24px, large and calm, one to three lines; captions at 20px, sentence case. Ratio about 4.6x. Keep the display to one or two short lines, because open leading lets each line stand alone. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink soft but at 4.5:1 or better; the accent muted and rare, on the primary action only. Motion: lines arrive with the dealt entrance; hover warms ink a little.
phone: Display 11vw (about 43px) at leading 1.3; steps 34 / 30px; body 20px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after the pass: entrance as dealt, body paragraphs of one to three lines, accent off cards.

name: Poster didone over a grotesque h2
description: A high-contrast didone at 400 in mixed case as a poster at 20vw over a neo-grotesque for the h2 and everything read. The poster is about 290px at 1440 (lh 1.0, -0.005em), one or two words of at most eight letters in all, on one line; at this size the fine strokes hold, and below 120px the display face appears only as a whole pull-quote line at 40px. Below the poster a sans h2 at 66px (500, lh 0.91, -0.03em, max 820px, at most two lines), h3 at 40px and body at 18px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters). Ratio about 16x from poster to body. No italics on words: italics only on a whole pull-quote line. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Poster fitted to the width between the phone margins (about 86px); h2 36px; h3 26px; body 17px.
houseRuleCheck: No italic or styled word inside a headline; italics only on a whole pull-quote line. The poster word is never a giant name in the footer.

name: Extended black caps, one family
description: Faces: one wide extended grotesque at 900 for display and the h3, and 500 for text. Display at 9.6vw (138px at 1440, leading 0.92) and 88px, caps, two lines at most; the h3 in 900 caps at 28px; body and small text in sentence case at 16px, weight 500; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Ratio about 9x. Extended letters are wide: a 138px line holds about seven letters across a 1260px measure, so headlines are three words or fewer and short words. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action only. Motion: the display arrives with the dealt entrance as whole words, never letter by letter; hover changes ink.
phone: Display 10-11vw (about 40-44px), words of eight letters or fewer; body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only at 28px and up; body and small text in sentence case; buttons and entrance as dealt, no letter-by-letter stagger.

name: Light extended caps, compact scale
description: Faces: one extended grotesque (wide letterforms, wide set) carries every tier, all in capitals and all untracked. Display at 400, 48px at 1440 (3.3vw, lh 1.1), one or two lines of at most 22 characters, max 880px wide. Text at 600 and 16px (lh 1.45, at most 38 characters a line because the face runs wide), at most two sentences in a block; captions and list items use the same 16px 600, and buttons are the dealt button. The hierarchy comes from the change from 400 to 600 and from ink (display in the ink, text in the dealt muted tone at 4.5:1 or better), not from size jumps. Ratio about 3x: a calm, compact scale that leaves the pictures and the space to do the talking. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Emphasis is a whole line, never a word inside a headline. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Display clamp(26px, 7.2vw, 48px) on at most two lines (a headline of at most 30 characters); text 16px capitals with lines of at most 28 characters; same weights and ink steps.
houseRuleCheck: Nothing under 16px and nothing tracked; capitals only in blocks of at most two sentences, and no decorative accent cut; no label above a heading.

name: Heavy extended heads, plain extended text
description: One extended-width grotesque family in two weights, no second face. Hero line (the display step): mixed case 800 at 150px at 1440 (lh 0.9, -0.03em), at most two lines of 12 characters, set on the left page margin. Section heads: capitals 800 at 40px (lh 0.95, -0.02em, max 760px, one or two lines of at most 20 characters); card and sub heads: capitals 800 at 20px (lh 1.05). Body: 400 at 16px (lh 1.5, max 46 characters, in the ink or the dealt muted tone); captions 14px sentence case 400, never capitals. Ratio about 9x from hero to body and 2.5x from head to body, so the weight and the width do the work, not a long ladder. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent on the action fill and on one large figure the page states, never a headline word. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Hero clamp(40px, 11vw, 56px) on at most two lines; heads 26px; sub heads 18px; body 16px with lines of at most 30 characters.
houseRuleCheck: Captions are 14px sentence case, never small capitals; the hero line is plain text, not logo art, and never a giant name in the footer; no label above a heading.

name: Margin-to-margin extended caps word
description: One extended grotesque, weight 800, capitals. The headline is a single word of four to nine letters fitted to the full content width: the viewport minus the page margins (1344px at 1440 with 48px margins, about 93vw), never 100vw, so it never touches an edge. The size is computed, not guessed: measure the word at 100px with canvas text metrics, scale it to the width and recompute on resize; that gives about 215-250px at 1440 for six letters, lh 0.85, -0.01em, one line. Under it after 40-64px: a lead at 20px (weight 300, -0.025em, lh 1.5, max 520px, in the dealt muted tone) and captions at 14px sentence case 500. Use the word where the page needs one loud idea: the hero headline where the hero blueprint allows a one-word line, or one mid-page statement. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Word fitted to the width between the phone margins (about 62px for six letters); over eight letters it may break into two fitted lines, never under 48px; lead 17px.
houseRuleCheck: The word stops at the page margins, never at the screen edge, and is a content word, never a name or email in the footer; one such word on the page.

name: Bold geometric caps, compact
description: One geometric sans (circular bowls, single-storey a, even strokes) in 700, capitals at every tier, untracked. Hero 62px at 1440 (4.3vw, lh 0.9, max 840px, one or two lines of at most 24 characters), section head 54px, sub head 24px (lh 1.05), lead 20px, body and captions 16px (lh 1.4); there is no 14px tier, so nothing small is in capitals, and buttons are the dealt button. Body in capitals runs at most two lines of 36 characters at a time; longer reading goes in sentence case at 17px 500. Ratio about 3.9x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Hero clamp(28px, 8vw, 62px) on at most two lines (a headline of about 28 characters); head 34px; sub head 22px; body 16px with lines of at most 28 characters.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals at 16px and up, untracked, in short blocks only; longer reading in sentence case.

name: Geometric flat heading ladder
description: One geometric sans, 400 only, mixed case. A nearly flat heading ladder at 1440: 57px, 51px and 44px (4vw, 3.5vw, 3vw; lh 1.05-1.1, -0.04em), a lead at 19px and body at 18px and 16px (-0.02em, lh 1.4). Step ratio about 1.13, whole scale about 3.6x. With so little size difference the hierarchy is carried by position and ink (h1 and h2 in the ink, h3 and the lead in the dealt muted tone) and by filled cards in the dealt card style that group things. Headlines run 18-26 characters a line, at most two lines, max 760px. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Heads 32 / 30 / 28px at lh 1.1, at most two lines; body 17px and 16px; tracking kept; cards stack in one column.
houseRuleCheck: Grouping comes from filled cards, never outlines, and the page is not boxes only.

name: Grotesque display, bold second voice
description: Faces: one grotesque at 400-500 sets the display and the body; a stronger cut of the same family (the dealt face's heavier weight, or its wide sibling) is the second voice. Display in mixed case at 6.4-6.7vw (92-96px at 1440), leading 0.95-1.1, two lines at most; heads at 62 / 54 / 32-40px; body 18-20px at leading 1.45. The second voice (weight 600-700) carries navigation, card titles and short bold lines: 15-17px in sentence case with no tracking, never on tags, chips or a coloured fill; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Ratio 4.6-5.3x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink one step off full contrast; cards sit on the one surface tone and the accent stays on the primary action and links. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; hover on a card title changes ink only.
phone: Display 11vw (42-44px); second voice 15px; card titles keep the bold voice; one column.
houseRuleCheck: The second voice is 15-17px sentence case on navigation, card titles and short lines: no tags or chips, no coloured fill, no small caps label and no line above a heading.

name: Mixed-case display, caps sub-heads
description: Faces: one grotesque at weight 500 with the hierarchy turned round: the biggest type is in mixed case and the middle heads are capitals. Display in mixed case at 13.9vw (200px at 1440, lh 0.9) and a second step at 100px, at most 10 characters a line. Sub heads in capitals at 51px (h2) and 41px (h3), lh 1.0, untracked, max 720px and at most two lines. Body 24px (400, lh 1.5, max 46 characters, at most three lines a block), captions 15px sentence case 500. Step ratio about 2, whole ratio about 8x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Display 58px, second step 44px, capitals sub heads 28px and 24px (at most two lines), body 18px.
houseRuleCheck: No small caps labels: captions are 15px sentence case; capitals only for the 41-51px sub heads. One family only, so no serif accent face.

name: Hairline didone ladder
description: A thin (200) didone display ladder in mixed case, 13vw at the top, over a grotesque for body and captions. The ladder is close and tight: 190px at 1440 (lh 0.8), then 104px, 96px and 72px (lh 0.8-0.9), a headline of at most two lines of 12 characters, max 1100px; below 72px the display face is not used. Body 16px (lh 1.6, max 52 characters), captions 16px sentence case 500. Ratio about 12x. Thin strokes need contrast to survive: the ink at full strength on the ground (on a light page and a dark one alike), never the muted tone; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: 13vw becomes 52px minimum; the 72px step becomes 38px at weight 300 below 480px; body 16px; headlines at most two lines.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: the thin face takes the strongest ink on the page, and no label stands above a heading.

name: Hand-lettered caps over rounded text
description: A hand-lettered condensed display face in capitals, set as live text and never as a drawn graphic, over a rounded sans for reading. Heads at 50px for sections and 34px for cards at 1440 (lh 1.0, untracked), plus one optional hero step at 72px on at most two lines of 18 characters. Reading text in the rounded sans: body 18px (lh 1.45, 400, max 52 characters), lead 20px, captions 15px at 500, sentence case. Ratio about 2.8x for the heads, up to 4x with the hero step. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent (a bright flat hue) on the action fill and on figures. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; card hover as the dealt cards have it.
phone: Hero 44px, heads 34px and 26px, body 17px; headings wrap to at most two lines.
houseRuleCheck: The lettered face is a font set as live text, not a drawn shape or illustration; captions are sentence case.

name: Heavy extended display, plain grotesk text
description: An extended grotesque at its heaviest dealt weight (800, or 850 if the face has a variable axis) in mixed case for the display only, over a plain grotesque at 400 for everything else. Display 72px (5vw at 1440, lh 1.0, -0.01em, one or two lines of at most 18 characters), sub heads at 33px and 24px. Body 16px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters), captions 14px sentence case. Ratio about 4.5x. The width and the weight give the voice; the text face stays quiet. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent on the action fill and on one figure the page states. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Display 38px, sub heads 26px and 22px, body 16px; extended heads wrap early, at most two lines.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: captions are sentence case and no label stands above a heading.

name: Large-body single neo-grotesk
description: One neo-grotesque at 400 and everything big: display 97px at 1440 (6.8vw), h3 52px, h4 37px and a large body of 30px, mixed case, tracking -0.02em, headings at lh 1.1 and the body at lh 1.2. The only small tier is 16px sentence case 500 (lh 1.3) for captions; buttons are the dealt button. Ratio about 3.3x, so contrast comes from ink and space, not size: heads in the ink, body in the dealt muted tone. A 30px body means at most 44 characters a line and at most three lines a paragraph, so the page carries few words. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; hovering a link row lifts its ink from the muted tone to full ink (160ms).
phone: Display 48px, h3 34px, h4 28px, body 22px at lh 1.2 (at most four lines); captions 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Captions are 16px sentence case, never small capitals.

name: Light caps display, plain small text
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque with a real light cut (200-300; 100 only if it stays legible at 108px and up). Display in caps at 7.5-10vw (108-144px at 1440), weight 200-300, leading 0.9-1.0, tracking 0 to +0.01em, one or two lines; section headings reuse the display at its low end, so there is no mid step. Text and captions are the same sans in sentence case at 16px, weight 400, leading 1.5; navigation and buttons keep the dealt designs. Ratio 7-9x. Light strokes thin out on screen, so set the display ink one step softer than full contrast on a dark ground and never paler than the display on a pale one. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent on the primary action only. Motion: the display arrives with the dealt entrance; hover brightens ink.
phone: Display 10-11vw (40-44px), weight stepped up to 300 so strokes hold; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Only the display is in capitals; text and captions are 16px sentence case; the entrance, navigation and buttons are as dealt; the id's 'micro-caps' no longer applies.

name: Light flared serif, very tight
description: A light (300) flared serif (stroke ends widen slightly, a chiselled feel) in mixed case for the display over a grotesque for body and captions. Display 8vw at 1440 (117px) and one step at 60px, tracked very tight at -0.07em, lh 1.0, one or two lines of at most 16 characters. Body at 19-21px tracked -0.04em (never smaller than 18px at this tightness), lh 1.4, max 48 characters; captions 14px sentence case 500 at -0.01em, since small type is not tightened. Ratio about 5.6x. No italics on words and no capitals. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Display 52px and 36px at -0.05em; body 17px at -0.02em; headlines at most two lines.
houseRuleCheck: No italic words and no capitals: captions are 14px sentence case with normal tracking.

name: Wide grotesque, flat scale
description: A wide grotesque with crisp, squared terminals at 500-700 for headings over a regular grotesque for text. The display is only 2.5-2.8vw (36-40px at 1440), leading 0.9-1.2, tracking -0.02em, mixed case, two lines at most, and the other steps sit close: 33 / 30 / 26 / 20px, with text at 16px, leading 1.5. Ratio about 2.5x. The scale is flat: rank comes from cards on the one surface tone, change of ground and weight, not from size. Lines run 52-60 characters, text on five or six of the twelve columns. A small display cannot fill the first screen, so the dealt hero's product window carries it, with the headline beside it or on a quiet area of it. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink one step off full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; the dealt cards keep their own hover.
phone: Display 26-28px, steps 24 / 22 / 20, text 16px; cards stack.
houseRuleCheck: A page only of boxes is banned: deal it with a product-window or picture section between the card sections; cards sit on the one surface tone.

name: Neo display with a script voice
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at 400 in mixed case with a huge display, and one connected script (brush or pen lettering, live text, loaded for this one use) as a human voice for short notes. Display 12.8vw at 1440 (184px, lh 1.0, -0.02em, one or two lines of at most 10 characters), heads at 43px and 25px (lh 1.1). Reading text 18px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters), captions 15px sentence case 500. The script sets a single short note at 28px, lh 1.1, at most twice on the page, never inside a headline and never as body. Ratio about 10x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent for the script note (contrast at least 4.5:1) and the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Display 58px, heads 30px and 24px, script note 24px; headlines at most two lines.
houseRuleCheck: The script is a standalone note, at most twice per page, never a styled word in a headline and never body text; captions are sentence case.

name: Old-style heads, extended wayfinding face
description: An old-style serif (soft stress, calligraphic feel) at 400 in mixed case for headings over a neo-grotesque at 400 for reading and everything small. Headings 93px at 1440 (6.5vw, lh 1.0, max 900px, one or two lines) and 53px. Reading text and link lists 17px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters); captions 15px sentence case 500 (+0.02em); the dealt navigation sets its own links. Ratio about 5.3x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill and on link hover. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; in a link list, hovering one link takes its siblings to the muted tone while it holds full ink (180ms).
phone: Headings 46px and 32px (at most two lines), body 17px, captions 15px.
houseRuleCheck: Captions are 15px sentence case, never small tracked capitals; list text stays at the body size.

name: Two-size quiet sans
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at 400 in mixed case on a quiet scale: text at 16px (lh 1.25, max 46 characters) and credits and captions at 13px (lh 1.25) in the dealt muted tone, nothing smaller; section headings sit at 28px in the same weight, and only the hero headline takes the dealt display step. The hierarchy comes from outside the type: pictures at 40% of the viewport or more, 160px or more of space between groups, and the ink against the muted tone. The first screen is one full-bleed picture with the hero headline set on its quietest area, no box behind it. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; hovering a text row lifts its ink from the muted tone to full ink (160ms).
phone: Same 16px and 13px; headings 24px; pictures full width; one text group per screen.
houseRuleCheck: Nothing under 13px and nothing in capitals; the picture is never a documentary photograph, and the headline sits on its own quiet area, not on a box.

name: Rounded bold system
description: One rounded sans (rounded terminals) for everything, no decorative face. Display 700 at 4.4vw at 1440 (64px, lh 1.15, -0.01em, one or two lines of at most 22 characters), then 48px and 32px (lh 1.375), a 19px sub head and body 17px 400 (lh 1.41, max 56 characters). Buttons are the dealt button. Ratio about 3.8x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent (a bright flat hue) on the action fill and on figures. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Display 40px, 32px and 26px steps (at most two lines), body 17px; the dealt button full width.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: no tracked small capitals anywhere; captions are sentence case.

name: Screen-filling condensed caps
description: A condensed grotesque in capitals as the only display face, enormous at 30vw, over a neo-grotesque for one statement and the plain text. The word is three to seven letters at 432px at 1440 (lh 0.8) on one line, kept inside the 1344px content width. Section heads in the condensed caps at 100px and 40px (lh 0.9, at most two lines). A real figure the page states (a year, a price, a quantity) may take the same caps at 100px, set in the line that says what it counts, never as a band of figures. Between the display and the text, one statement in the sans as a two-line headline at 60px (-0.04em, lh 1.0, max 760px), then plain text at 20px (lh 1.45, max 52 characters). Ratio about 22x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Word fitted to one line between the phone margins; heads 48px and 28px; statement 32px on two lines; text 17px.
houseRuleCheck: A figure is a real statement (a year, a price) set inside the line that says what it counts, never 01/02/03 numbering, a counter or a stats band; the word stays inside the page margins and is never a name or email in the footer.

name: One serif for display and reading
description: Faces: one transitional serif sets the display and the reading text; a neo-grotesque appears only in small interface text. Display at 5vw in mixed case (72px at 1440, lh 1.0, -0.03em, one or two lines of at most 20 characters), h2 54px, and a large reading body at 30px (lh 1.2, max 44 characters, at most three lines a paragraph). Captions and fine print in the sans at 14px sentence case 500; buttons and navigation are the dealt ones. Ratio about 2.4x. No italic on words: italics only for a whole pull quote or an attribution line. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Display 40px, h2 34px, body 22px at lh 1.25 (at most four lines), captions 14px.
houseRuleCheck: No italic words; captions are 14px sentence case.

name: Serif and sans at one display size
description: A didone at regular weight in mixed case for one display line over a neo-grotesque that sets the other line at the same 7vw size and all the reading text. Display about 100px at 1440 (lh 0.95, -0.025em). The two faces take whole lines, never single words: a headline is two stacked lines, line one in the display face and line two in the sans; scale the sans down about 4% so the x-heights match and the lines read as one size. For a harder contrast the sans line may take its heaviest dealt weight against the display face at its lightest. No italics. Body in the sans at 17px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters), captions 14px sentence case 500. Ratio about 6x. Colour: one flat ground, one ink for both lines; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Both faces 11vw (about 43px), alternating by line, two lines at most; body 17px.
houseRuleCheck: The faces alternate by whole line, never a single styled word inside a line; no italics.

name: Single bold headline step
description: A scene-level type note with exactly one step: a bold (700) sans headline at 6.7vw at 1440 (96px, lh 1.15, -0.01em), one or two lines of at most 22 characters, max 1000px, left or centred. There is no body tier on the screen: the screen carries the headline and at most one dealt button. Use the page's chosen display face at its heaviest dealt weight, never a default system face. Colour: the ground is the section's own or the scene's, the ink is the pole that reads on it, and no accent on the headline. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; on a scrubbed scene the words may reach full ink one after another, starting from the dealt muted tone.
phone: 40px at lh 1.15, at most two lines of 14 characters; one dealt button above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: Use the page's own display face, never a default system face; no label above the headline.

name: One book serif, flat scale
description: Faces: one book serif (transitional or old-style) at 400 with a true italic kept for whole quotes. The top step is only 40-56px (2.75-3.9vw at 1440), leading 1.0-1.1, tracking -0.01em, two lines at most; then 44 / 32 / 24px, body 18px at leading 1.5, small 14px. Ratio 1.5-2.8x. Almost no size contrast, so rank comes from space, position and cards on the one surface tone; headings in sentence or title case. A small sans at 14px in sentence case for captions is optional. It reads like a printed book, so the dealt hero's large photograph has to fill the first screen. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink one step off full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; hover darkens ink.
phone: Top step 32-34px, body 18px at leading 1.5, nothing below 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Italics only for whole quotes, never for a word in a headline; no paper-and-terracotta pairing: ground and accent are the dealt ones.

name: Light neo-grotesque poster, big body
description: Faces: one light (300) neo-grotesque for everything, tracked tight, with a big body. Display at 10-17.4vw (144-250px at 1440, -0.05 to -0.07em, lh 0.84-0.9): at 17vw one word of up to nine letters on one line, kept inside the 1344px content width; at 10vw a line of two or three words. The h2 at 7-10vw (101-144px, same tracking, lh 0.95, at most two lines), a 38px sub where needed, body 24-26px (lh 1.33, max 48 characters, at most three lines a paragraph), a 19px secondary and captions 15px sentence case. Ratio 6-10x. Ink strength carries the rest of the hierarchy: display in the ink, body in the dealt muted tone. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; link hover swaps the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: One poster word fitted to one line between the phone margins (about 22vw, 86px), or a 52px line at -0.05em; h2 40-55px; body 19-20px; headlines at most two lines.
houseRuleCheck: The poster word is a content word inside the page margins, never a name or email in the footer; the face is light, so the display stays in full ink.

name: Compact single neo-grotesque
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque, mostly 400 (the display may go to 600). Top step 52-60px (3.6-4.2vw at 1440), leading 1.0-1.05, tracking -0.02em, mixed case, two lines at most; then 36 / 24 / 16 / 14px. Ratio 3.2-3.8x, with no separate label voice: captions are the body face at 14px, weight 500, sentence case; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Compact and exact, made for software and product pages. A 56px headline does not fill a first screen alone, so the dealt hero's large product window carries it. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink one step off full contrast; the one accent on the primary action, links and the active tab, never a card tint. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; tab and link hovers shift ink.
phone: Top step 34-38px, steps 26 / 20 / 16, captions 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after the pass: two-line headlines, captions 14px, buttons and entrance as dealt, accent off cards.

name: One medium sans, mid ratio
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque or geometric-leaning sans family at 400, 500 and 600 does every job. Display in mixed case at weight 400-500, clamp(56px, 7.5vw, 120px), about 108px at 1440, leading 0.95-1.05, two lines at most on a 9-10 column measure; tracking -0.01 to -0.03em at 500, or tightened to -0.05em at 400 for a sharper, exact voice. A five-step ladder runs 108 / 64 / 40 / 24 / 17px, with a 20-22px lead where a section needs one; body 17px at leading 1.5. Captions and legal lines are the body face at 14-15px, weight 500, sentence case; buttons keep the dealt button's label. Emphasis comes only from weight 600 on a sub-head. Colour: the dealt ground and ink, ink one step off full contrast; the accent stays on the primary action and links, never on a headline word and never as a card fill. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; links change colour on hover. It is the calm default: the type stays out of the way of the pictures and cards.
phone: Display 11-12vw (44-48px) at leading 1.05; ladder 44 / 30 / 22 / 17; same weights; one column with a measure of 32-36 characters.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after the pass: headlines two lines at most, buttons and entrance as dealt, accent kept off headlines and cards.

name: Small serif heads, grotesk body
description: A transitional serif at 400 for a few small headings over a grotesque at 400/500 that carries 95% of the text, in a shop-like system. The display face sets category and section heads at 40px at most (2.8vw at 1440) and card heads at 18px (lh 1.2); the hero headline takes the dealt display step. Body 16px (lh 1.5); captions 14px sentence case 500; product names and prices 16px 500; navigation is the dealt one. Ratio about 2.5x, step ratio about 1.13: a quiet page where the pictures are the loud part. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; card hover as the dealt cards have it.
phone: Serif 30px and 18px, body 16px, captions 14px; grid of two columns.
houseRuleCheck: Grouping comes from filled product cards in the dealt card style; no capitals and nothing below 14px.

name: Thin serif heads over a light sans
description: A thin flared serif (stroke ends widen slightly) on every heading step over a light-to-regular grotesque for the body. Heads at 86px (6vw at 1440) and 52px at weight 100-200, then 32px and 22px at weight 300 so the strokes stay visible; lh 1.0 at the top easing to 1.25 at 22px, no tracking, at most 20 characters a line, headlines at most two lines. A sharper, more upright cut works as well as a flared one; for a quieter page only the top step keeps the display face, at 80px and lh 1.2, and the lower heads move to the sans. Body at 16-18px (lh 1.4-1.55, max 52 characters), captions 15px sentence case 500. Italics only for a whole quote. Ratio about 5x. Thin strokes need the strongest contrast on the page: the ink at full strength on the ground, never the muted tone; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; no scroll motion on the type.
phone: Heads 50 / 36 / 26 / 21px, the top two at weight 200 and the lower two at 300 (or one 40px step at 300 when only the top step keeps the display face); body 16-17px.
houseRuleCheck: Italics only on whole quotes, never on words in headings; captions are 15px sentence case, never tracked capitals.

name: Tight sans with serif figures
description: A neo-grotesque at 500 for all words, display at 11.7vw, over a transitional serif used only for figures. The display is 168px at 1440 (-0.04em), one line of a word without descenders so a leading of 0.7 does not collide; at two lines, leading 0.85. Steps at 54px, 30px, 24px and 18px (lh 1.1-1.4); body 16-18px. Figures in the serif at 72px (lh 1.0): real numbers the page states, such as a price, a year or a quantity, set in the line that says what they count, never in a band of figures. Ratio about 9x from the display to the 18px step. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill, and the figures take the ink, not the accent. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; figures do not count up.
phone: Display 58px at lh 0.85 on at most two lines, steps 40/26/22/17px, figures 48px.
houseRuleCheck: Figures are real numbers the page states, never 01/02/03 numbering, a count-up counter or a stats band.

name: Tight sans, two-tier jump
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque with only two real tiers. Display at 600 in mixed case, 13.9vw (200px at 1440, -0.05em, lh 1.0), one or two lines of at most 10 characters each, set from the left margin; one h2 at 80px (600, -0.04em, lh 1.0, at most two lines). Then straight down to text at 500 and 16-24px (lh 1.3; tracking tight at 24px, near 0 at 16px), with no h3: sub heads are 24px text in the ink and body 16px in the dealt muted tone. Step ratio 2.5 from display to h2, about 11x from display to 18px text. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent on the action fill and on one figure, never on a headline word. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Display 15vw (about 58px) on at most two lines; h2 40px; text 17px at -0.01em.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: no h3 (sub heads are text-sized), and small text keeps normal tracking.

name: Tight transitional serif ladder
description: A transitional serif at 400 on a close heading ladder over a neo-grotesque at 500 for text. Top head 84px (5.8vw at 1440, lh 0.9, -0.02em, at most two lines), section heads 63px and 58px, card heads 42px and small heads 21px (lh 1.0-1.2). Text 16px (lh 1.45, max 52 characters) and, where the page states one, a stat figure at 47px in the sans, set in the line that says what it counts. Ratio about 5x from top head to text. Because the steps sit close, the hierarchy is carried by position and by filled cards in the dealt card style that group the content. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; card hover as the dealt cards have it.
phone: Heads 44/36/34/28/20px (at most two lines), text 16px, figure 38px.
houseRuleCheck: The figure is a real stat set in its own line, never 01/02/03 numbering or a stats band.

name: Flat compact sans, one weight
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at one weight (500) on a deliberately flat scale. Section headings at 36-44px in mixed case (lh 0.92, -0.02 to -0.05em, max 520px, one or two lines of 22 characters) and body at 16px (lh 1.35, max 52 characters, at most three lines a block); a longer page may add one 30-33px step and a 20px lead, never more. The hero headline takes the dealt display step. Ratio about 2.2-2.7x. The hierarchy comes from ink (headings in the ink, body in the dealt muted tone) and from placement, and the page groups its content in a few filled cards in the dealt card style (fills, no outlines) so the flat type still reads in clear groups. Colour: the dealt ground, the surface tone for the cards and the ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance; the type stays still.
phone: Headline 30px at lh 0.95, body 16px, cards full width.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are filled, never outlined, and the page is not boxes only: deal it with a picture or window between the card groups.

name: Very tight sans, graduated ladder
description: Faces: one medium (400-500) sans with tracking of -0.04 to -0.06em on every display step, even the 33px one; body stays near -0.01 to -0.02em for reading. Six steps from 10-12vw (144-175px at 1440, leading 0.8-0.95) through 107 / 80 / 53 / 33px, then 17px body, all in mixed case; headlines two lines at most. Ratio 7-13x. The signature is the tracking, and the steps are graduated: hero 144-175px, section titles 80-107px, card titles 33px. Colour: the dealt ground and ink at full contrast; the accent on the primary action and links only, never a card or button fill beyond the dealt button. Motion: headlines arrive with the dealt entrance; link hover changes colour.
phone: Ladder times 0.4 (60 / 44 / 32 / 24 / 20); tracking held at -0.04em, since more makes letters collide.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after the pass: tracking is the one signature; entrance as dealt; card titles at the sub step, not display size.

name: Wide-tracked geometric caps
description: Faces: one geometric sans in capitals with open tracking on the display only. Display light (300) in capitals at 4.3vw at 1440 (62px, +0.32em, lh 1.3, one or two lines of at most 14 characters, centred or left); heads in capitals at 50px and 40px, +0.045em, lh 1.4, at most two lines. A 20px capitals lead at +0.045em, then a sentence-case 24px h4 and body 16px (lh 1.6, max 52 characters). Tracking is used only at 20px and above; captions and small text are 16px sentence case, so nothing small is spaced out. Ratio about 3.9x. Colour: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only on the action fill. Motion: arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Display 30px at +0.2em on at most two lines; heads 28px and 24px at +0.03em; lead 17px; body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Tracked capitals only at 20px and up; every small tier is sentence case, so no letter-spaced labels.
